opportunities.fullDescription:
VACANCY: Rental & Admin Coordinator
Location: Johannesburg – Kempton Park
Supporting the Durban (DBN) and Cape Town (CPT) branches, while assisting the Johannesburg branch.

About the Role:
We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Rental & Admin Coordinator to join the team.
This role is responsible for coordinating rental administration, managing sales orders, updating operational systems, liaising with branches and vendors, and ensuring all rental activities are accurately processed and completed.

Key Responsibilities:
• Open Sales Orders for:
- Services
- Inspections
- CIS (Check, Inspect & Service Batteries)
- Battery Maintenance Agreements (BMA)
- Breakdowns
- Deliveries
- Collections
• Rental Return Inspections
• Follow up with regional branches and vendors on outstanding Sales Orders.
• Download and review inspection reports.
• Distribute completed inspection, service, and breakdown reports.
• Source quotations for repairs, replacements, and load testing.
• Upload and maintain customer portals
• Upload completed job cards onto our ERP system.
• Capture equipment hours on the customer portal.
• Close completed Sales Orders.
• Provide administrative support to the National Operations team.
• Perform additional administrative duties as required.
• Manage the switchboard
• Assist walk-in customers.

Minimum Requirements:
• Grade 12 (Matric).
• Minimum 2–3 years' experience in an administrative or operations coordination role.
• Previous experience in the forklift, material handling or rental industry will be advantageous.
• Strong computer literacy, particularly Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Word.
• Experience working on ERP systems.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• High attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to work independently as well as within a team.

Key Competencies:
• Excellent administrative and coordination skills.
• Strong problem-solving ability.
• Customer service oriented.
• Ability to prioritize workload.
• Professional and reliable.
• Strong follow-up and communication skills.

Please note: Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical Microsoft Office competency test as part of the recruitment process. The assessment will include Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.

Working hours: Monday to Friday 08H00AM to 16H30PM
Probation period: 3 Months - At the end of the period, you will either become a permanent employee, have your probation extended for further evaluation, or be dismissed

What The Company Offers:
• Opportunity to work within a growing Company.
• Supportive and collaborative team environment.
• Professional growth and development opportunities.
• Company Cellphone (Includes airtime & data) for business use only

Salary range is between R10 000 & R15 000 CTC, depending on experience.
